name: Hoosierland Campground
note: Family campground north of Alexandria around a swimming pond with a sand beach: full hookup with 50-amp $40/night, 30-amp $35, water/electric $30, primitive tent $25; weekly and monthly rates; many long-stay sites. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: hoosierlandcampground.com live; nightly rates read by AWH 2026-10-02 (FHU 50A $40, 30A $35, W/E $30); Google 4.4 over 193 with phone; RV Life lists it, unrated. The rate block is shared on the page of sister park Big Oak (excluded 2026-06 as workforce); off-season imagery shows dense long-stay clusters on the west loops
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 40.2907,-85.6220: RV rows ring a ~2 ha swimming pond with a sand beach; the north and east rows sit on open grass within ~15-20 m of the water - pond
